meta.title: Moolam
meta.description: A passport for every AI generated image, registered on Monad the moment it is made and verifiable from any re-encoded copy.
meta.home: A passport on Monad says who made a picture, which agent drew it, how AI may use it. Strip it, shrink it, screenshot it: the passport still finds it.

header.themeDarkAction: Theme: dark, switch to the light theme
header.themeLightAction: Theme: light, switch to the dark theme

check.title: Check any picture

make.line: Register an image in the studio. Two signatures, about a second, and it carries a record nobody can quietly edit.

agents.formulaPlain: Each re-check that matched raises the score and each miss lowers it; an upheld dispute counts as two misses. A new agent starts at 50.

shared.title: Platforms strip the credential on upload.
shared.body: The copies keep travelling anyway: recompressed, shrunk to a tenth, turned, mirrored, run through a social pipeline. Every one of them has lost the file that said where it came from.

trusted.title: Trust an agent earns image by image.
trusted.counts: {rechecks, plural, =1 {# re-check} other {# re-checks}}, {passports, plural, =1 {# passport} other {# passports}}
trusted.body: Every re-check written back on chain is counted against this agent's own id, and the index adds them up into this score. Its standing is the sum of its work, not a claim on a website.
trusted.noAgent: No agent made this one, so no agent standing hangs on it. When an agent does sign, every check the verifier runs is written back to the ERC-8004 reputation registry under that agent's own id.

verify.title: Verify an image
verify.lede: Upload any copy. Moolam fingerprints it three ways and searches every registered passport, so a resized or re-encoded file still finds its record.
verify.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 20 MB. The check starts the moment you choose a file.
verify.pending: Fingerprinting the image and searching the registry.
verify.verdict: Yes. This is the same picture as {title}.
verify.verdictExact: Yes. Byte for byte, this is the file registered as {title}.
verify.noneHint: This picture is not in the registry. Moolam does not match crops yet, so a piece of a registered picture will not be found. Try the whole picture.
verify.manifestPresent: The signed C2PA record is still inside this file.
verify.manifestMissing: The signed C2PA record has been stripped from this file. The fingerprints matched anyway.
verify.offline: The verifier service is not answering. Start it with npm run dev:verifier from the repo root, then try again.
verify.dropTitle: Choose an image, or drop one here.
verify.privacy: Your browser sends the file straight to {host}, the Moolam verify service. It is fingerprinted there, matched against the registry, and never stored.
verify.checkingHeading: Reading the picture, not the file name.
verify.checkingDetail: Three fingerprints, all eight orientations, then a search of every registered passport. A few seconds.
verify.idleBody: Drop a file in. The answer lands on this card.

steps.fingerprint: Fingerprint the file three ways: the exact bytes, how it looks, and its layout.
steps.rotate: Try all eight ways the picture could be turned or mirrored.
steps.search: Search every registered passport and answer with the closest one.

verify.noPicture: The picture's storage is not answering right now
verify.others: {count, plural, =1 {# other passport was in range} other {# other passports were in range}}, and this one was closest.
verify.firstRegistered: An earlier registration matches this picture. <link>Open the first registration</link>.
verify.laterSameFingerprint: {count, plural, =1 {# later registration shares} other {# later registrations share}} this fingerprint.
verify.pixelsUnread: This is the registered file byte for byte. Its pixels could not be read, so no look or layout comparison was made.
verify.staleIndex: Moolam's copy of the register is {minutes} minutes old, so a picture registered since then may not show yet.
verify.manifestInvalid: The Content Credentials inside this file fail validation: the file was changed after signing, or the record was copied in from another file. The fingerprints matched anyway.
verify.manifestUnreadable: This file carries Content Credentials we could not read, so we cannot say whether they hold. The fingerprints matched anyway.
verify.manifestCredentialExpired: The signature is intact. The certificate that made it has since expired.
verify.manifestCredentialUntrusted: The signature is intact. The certificate that made it is not one this check trusts.
verify.lookupFailed: The registry has not answered for that id. It may be a block or two behind.

recheck.noneNote: No independent workflow has fetched this picture and recomputed its fingerprint.
recheck.matched: Checked again by a Chainlink CRE workflow on {at}: it re-fetched the picture, recomputed the fingerprint and matched, {count} of 64 bits apart.
recheck.mismatched: A Chainlink CRE workflow re-fetched this picture on {at}, recomputed the fingerprint and did not match: {count} of 64 bits apart.

dispute.upheld: A challenge against this passport was upheld. Treat its record, and its statement on AI use, as unreliable.
dispute.inherited: An earlier version of this picture lost a challenge. <link>Open that version</link>.
dispute.rejected: A challenge was raised against this passport and rejected.

sealed.matched: Matches a sealed passport. The registered picture is not published.
sealed.label: Sealed

passport.title: Passport
passport.notFound: No passport with that id. Check the id, or find it from the verify page.
passport.error: The registry could not be read: {reason}. Reload the page.
passport.creator: Creator

attestations.heading: Checked again, by someone else
attestations.empty: No verification has been written for this passport yet. The Chainlink workflow adds one when it re-checks the image.
attestations.receiver: Written on Monad by Moolam's Chainlink receiver
attestations.body: Anyone can say a picture is theirs. This part is different: Chainlink's CRE workflow downloaded the picture itself, took its fingerprint again and wrote the result on Monad.
attestations.byChainlink: Checked again by a Chainlink CRE workflow

delivery.simulation: Chainlink's CRE simulator ran this check on one machine, not across Chainlink's network.
delivery.network: Several independent Chainlink machines ran this check and agreed on the answer.

attestations.noTransaction: The transaction link is not available for this one yet.
attestations.verdict: A Chainlink CRE workflow re-fetched this picture and recomputed its fingerprint: <apart>{bits} of 64 bits apart</apart>.
attestations.gridNote: The first grid is the fingerprint the registry stored when this picture was registered. The second is what the workflow computed from the file it fetched itself. Every cell that disagrees is marked.
attestations.whatIsRecheck: A re-check is a Chainlink CRE workflow fetching this file for itself, computing the fingerprint again and writing that answer on Monad. Nobody can write one about their own picture.

private.lead: Re-checked privately by a Chainlink confidential workflow, from the small copy Moolam keeps.
private.leadEarlier: Re-checked privately by a Chainlink confidential workflow, from the small copy Moolam kept at the time.
private.limit: It ran in Chainlink's simulator on one machine, not inside Chainlink's secure hardware.
private.verdict: A Chainlink confidential workflow opened the small private copy Moolam kept of this picture and compared its fingerprint: <apart>{bits} of 64 bits apart</apart>.
private.gridNote: The first grid is the fingerprint the registry stored when this picture was registered. The second is what the workflow computed from Moolam's small private copy. Every cell that disagrees is marked.

attestations.sealedBody: Anyone can say a picture is theirs. This part is different: a second party checks the fingerprint and writes the answer on Monad. A sealed picture has no public file, so its check is private: when its creator asked for one, a Chainlink confidential workflow opens the small private copy Moolam keeps and compares the fingerprint.

unknown.lead: Written on Monad by an unknown writer
unknown.verdict: An unknown writer reported this fingerprint for the picture: <apart>{bits} of 64 bits apart</apart>.
unknown.gridNote: The first grid is the fingerprint the registry stored when this picture was registered. The second is the one this writer reported. Moolam does not know who runs this writer, so this page does not say how the picture was checked.

children.empty: No edit has been registered from this passport.

edit.body: Upload the edited picture with a line on what changed. It is pinned, fingerprinted and registered as a child of this passport, sent from your own account.
edit.notConfigured: No signer is set up on this deployment, so an edit cannot be added from here yet.

signer.what: A signer is a permission you give this app to add edits to your passports, limited to that one action by a policy Privy enforces.
signer.policy: This permission can only add edits to your passports.
signer.granting: Privy is asking for your permission
signer.granted: This app can add edits from your wallet

form.title: Title

pin.failed: The edited picture was not pinned

send.running: Sending from your account through Privy. Moolam pays the fee.
send.watching: Watching for your edit to land on Monad.
send.pending: Sent, and Monad has not shown it yet
send.failed: The edit did not reach the registry

done.label: Recorded
done.body: The edit is on chain as its own passport, carrying this one as its parent. Anyone can check a copy against it.
done.feeSponsored: Sponsored by Privy. You paid nothing.

failure.noSigner: This app does not have your permission to add edits. Allow edits from this app and the edit can go out.
failure.notOwner: This account does not hold this passport, so it cannot add an edit to it.
failure.noParent: The registry has no passport with this id, so there is nothing to add an edit to.
failure.quota: That is {used} of {limit} edits for today. The allowance comes back at {at}.
failure.sendFailed: The registry refused the edit, so nothing was recorded.
failure.sendPending: The edit went out and the service could not see it land in time. It may still be on its way, so it must not be sent again. Ask Monad again in a moment.
failure.dependencyDown: A service this edit needs did not answer, so nothing was sent and nothing was spent. Try again in a minute.
failure.signFailed: Privy would not sign the send, so nothing was recorded.
failure.pinFailed: The edited picture could not be pinned to IPFS, so nothing was sent.
failure.busy: The service is running as many edits at once as it can. Try again in a moment.
failure.offline: The verify service did not answer, so nothing was sent.
failure.signedOut: This session is signed out, so the service would not take the edit.
failure.tooLarge: That file is over the 20 MB limit. Choose a smaller copy.
failure.fingerprintUnstable: This edit changes too little from side to side for a fingerprint that survives copying, so the Chainlink re-check and any search for its copies would miss it. Nothing was pinned or sent. An edit with more detail across its width will register.
failure.signedFileTooLarge: Adding the passport's signature would take this file past 20 MB, the most a check can read back. Export it smaller and try again. Nothing was pinned or sent.
failure.thumbnailTooLarge: This picture cannot be reduced to a thumbnail small enough for the Chainlink verifier to fetch, so its passport could never be re-checked. Nothing was pinned or sent.
failure.notAnImage: That is not an image file. Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP.
failure.empty: That file is empty. Choose the picture again.
failure.rateLimited: Too many requests from here for now. Wait a moment and try again.
failure.badRequest: The service turned the request down.
failure.badResponse: The service answered in a shape this app does not know.
failure.confirmPending: The edit was accepted and Monad has not shown it yet. It may still land, so it must not be sent again.
failure.titleMissing: Give the edit a title first.
failure.grantDeclined: The permission was not given, so this app still cannot add edits.
failure.grantFailed: Privy could not add the signer to your wallet.
failure.alreadyRegistered: This exact image is already registered. The first registration wins, so open the passport that holds it.
failure.unknown: The edit did not go through.
failure.serviceFault: This was a fault on Moolam's side, not a problem with your picture. Nothing was saved. Try again in a minute.

edit.lineageNote: Only the owner can add edits. The app's Privy permission can add edits and nothing else.

passport.noPicture: The picture's storage is not answering right now
passport.passkeyBound: This creator signs with a passkey tied to their account.
passport.passkeyNone: No passkey is bound to this creator's wallet.
passport.noAgent: No generating agent. This one was registered from a file the creator uploaded.
passport.fingerprintsBody: A verifier fetches the picture, hashes it again and compares it with these. Nothing here depends on the file name or on anything the metadata claims.

check.heading: Is your copy this picture?
check.body: Drop any copy here. It goes to the verifier, which fingerprints it and answers against this passport, not against the file name.
check.hint: A resized, re-encoded, turned or mirrored copy still matches. A crop does not, yet.
check.tooLarge: That file is over the 20 MB limit. Send a smaller copy.
check.notAnImage: That is not an image file. Drop a JPEG, PNG or WebP.
check.empty: That file is empty. Choose the picture again.
check.none: This copy matches no passport at all.
check.same: Yes. This is the same picture.
check.sameExact: Yes. Byte for byte, this is the file.
check.different: No. This copy belongs to a different passport.

dispute.body: Someone put a bond behind a claim that this record is wrong. The bond is held by the registry until the dispute is settled.
dispute.evidenceElsewhere: The evidence for this challenge points somewhere else:
dispute.waiting: Waiting for the dispute judge to decide.

outcome.open: Waiting for the dispute judge to decide.
outcome.upheld: The resolver agreed with the challenge. The bond went back to the challenger, and this record is marked disputed for good.
outcome.rejected: The resolver did not agree. The bond went to the treasury, and the record stands.

flag.heading: Put a bond behind the claim
flag.what: A dispute costs a bond of {bond} MON. The resolver named by the policy settles it: if they agree with you, the bond is credited back to you. If they do not, it goes to the treasury.
flag.whatUnknown: A dispute costs a bond, and the policy contract sets how much. The resolver named by the policy settles it: if they agree with you, the bond is credited back to you. If they do not, it goes to the treasury.
flag.fee: Moolam pays the network fee. It cannot pay the bond: that is your own MON, and it leaves your account the moment this lands.
flag.reasonLabel: What is wrong with this record
flag.reasonPlaceholder: Say what you know, and how somebody else could check it.
flag.reasonHint: Between {min} and {max} characters. It travels inside the transaction, so it is public and permanent.

account.waiting: Your account puts up the bond
account.done: Your account put up the bond
account.failed: Your account did not put up the bond

send.watching: Waiting for Monad to show it
send.unconfirmed: Sent, and Monad has not shown it yet

done.label: Recorded
done.heading: The challenge is on the record
done.body: This passport now says it is challenged, to everybody who opens it, until the resolver settles it.
done.bondHeldBody: Held by the registry itself until the dispute is settled. Nobody can move it.

failure.reasonShort: Say a little more. A challenge needs at least {min} characters, so the resolver has something to check.
failure.reasonLong: That is over {max} characters. All of it goes on chain, so keep the part that matters.
failure.notEnough: Your account is {short} MON short of the bond. Moolam pays the network fee, but the bond has to be your own MON.
failure.badBond: The bond changed while this panel was open, so the registry refused this amount. It has been read again, so try once more.
failure.alreadyOpen: Somebody has already challenged this passport, and the registry allows one open dispute at a time.
failure.alreadyDisputed: This passport is already marked disputed, so it cannot be challenged again.
failure.notFound: The registry has no passport with this id.
failure.paused: New records and new challenges are paused on the registry right now.
failure.declined: The window was closed before the transaction went out. Nothing was sent and nothing was spent.
failure.confirmPending: The challenge was accepted and Monad has not shown it yet. It may still land, so it must not be sent again.
failure.notResolver: Only the resolver named by the policy can settle a dispute.
failure.noOpenDispute: There is no open dispute on this passport.
failure.nothingOwed: The registry owes this account nothing.
failure.reverted: Monad rejected this, so nothing was written
failure.unknown: The challenge did not go out.

passport.noManifest: This file carried no Content Credentials.
passport.ipfsCid: Open the stored record on IPFS

consent.heading: How AI may use this picture
consent.lede: A file can carry a line saying its creator refuses AI training, and anyone can strip that line out on the way past. This is the same statement written to a register on Monad, where only the holder of this passport can write it and nobody can take it back out.

line.open: The holder allows all four uses in the standard, training included.
line.closed: The holder refuses all four uses in the standard. This is a choice, not a fault.
line.ask: The holder allows these uses only on their own conditions. Anyone who cannot ask has to read it as no.
line.mixed: This statement answers each use on its own terms.
line.none: Nobody has written a statement for this picture yet. Nothing stated is not permission.

consent.asking: asking the chain for that day
consent.askFailed: the chain did not answer for that day
consent.scrub: Drag the rule, or use the arrow keys
consent.dayLabel: The day to ask the chain about
consent.fourUsesNote: What stands today, use by use. Every summary loses something, and this is where training and inference are allowed to differ.

empty.body: Nobody has written a statement for this picture. It is reported here as silence, because that is what it is: no use has been allowed by it.
empty.holder: Only the wallet that holds this passport can write one, and every statement it writes stays on the record with its date.

consent.historyCount: {count, plural, =0 {No statement yet} =1 {One statement} other {# statements}}
consent.historyEmpty: This passport has no statements at all. The first one written will sit here with its date, and nothing written after it can take its place.
consent.unavailable: The register could not be read just now, so this page cannot say what the holder stated. That is not permission: ask again in a moment.

failure.notHolder: This wallet does not hold this passport any more, and only its holder can write for it.
failure.tooSoon: The register takes one statement per wallet every ten minutes for the same picture. This one opens again at {at}.
failure.conditionsRequired: A statement with conditions has to say what they are. Write them, and send it again.
failure.conditionsNotAllowed: Conditions belong to a statement that asks for them. Clear the text, or choose ask me first.
failure.conditionsTooLong: The conditions are longer than the 256 bytes the register keeps. Shorten them and send it again.
failure.conditionsNotPrintable: Use only the letters A to Z, numbers and common punctuation. Take out the line break or the accented letter and send it again.
failure.reverted: Monad mined this statement and it did nothing. Nothing was written, so it is safe to try once more.
failure.declined: You closed the prompt, so nothing was sent.
failure.confirmPending: The statement went out and Monad has not shown it yet. It may still land, so it must not be sent again: look again in a moment.
failure.unknown: The statement did not go through.

control.heading: Say how AI may use it
control.body: You hold this passport, so you are the only address the register takes a statement from. Moolam pays the network fee. The words are yours, and they stay on the record with the date you wrote them.

open.title: Open to AI use
open.line: Anyone may train on this picture, generate from it and mine it.

closed.title: Not for AI training
closed.line: No AI use at all. No training on it, no generating from it, no mining it.

ask.title: Ask me first
ask.line: Allowed on your conditions, written below. Anyone who cannot reach you has to read it as no.

control.conditionsPlaceholder: A licence, a page to read, or an address to ask at.
control.notPrintable: Use only the letters A to Z, numbers and common punctuation. Character {at} is not one the chain will accept, so a line break or an accented letter has to go before this can be written.

steps.confirming: Waiting for Monad to show it

control.locked: You wrote for this picture a moment ago. The register takes your next statement for it at {at}.
control.needsConditions: Say what your conditions are, and they go on chain with the statement.
control.unchanged: This is what the register already holds for this picture.
control.fee: Moolam pays the network fee. The statement goes out from your own wallet.
control.done: Written. The register has held this since {when}, and it is what anyone verifying this picture is told from now on.

consent.standardName: Written in the CAWG standard for AI training and data mining, v{version}

sealed.label: Sealed
sealed.posterLine: Registered on {date}. The picture is not published. Moolam keeps no copy.
sealed.posterLinePrivate: Registered on {date}. The picture is not published. Moolam keeps only a small private copy, for the private re-check.
sealed.standing: Sealed, so there is no public copy
sealed.commitmentAlgorithm: Fingerprinted with {algorithm}, a standard file fingerprint
sealed.commitmentLine: Anyone holding the file can hash it and compare it with the passport id.
sealed.recheck: No public copy to re-check. A re-check needs the picture to be published.

privateCopy.kept: A private re-check can run on the small copy Moolam keeps.
privateCopy.gone: Moolam's private copy was deleted, so no private re-check can run.
privateCopy.unknown: Moolam could not read the private copy's state just now.

sealed.edit: This passport is sealed, so it cannot be edited until the picture is published.

about.noCopy: Registered sealed: the picture was never published, and Moolam kept no copy of it. The passport id is the sha256 of the signed file, so this record commits to the exact bytes without showing them.
about.kept: Registered sealed: the picture was never published. At its creator's request, Moolam keeps one small private copy, used only for a private re-check by a Chainlink workflow. The passport id is the sha256 of the signed file, so this record commits to the exact bytes without showing them.
about.deleted: Registered sealed: the picture was never published. Moolam kept one small private copy for a private re-check by a Chainlink workflow, and that copy has since been deleted. The passport id is the sha256 of the signed file, so this record commits to the exact bytes without showing them.
about.asked: Registered sealed: the picture was never published. Its creator asked Moolam to keep one small private copy for a private re-check by a Chainlink workflow. The passport id is the sha256 of the signed file, so this record commits to the exact bytes without showing them.
about.published: Registered sealed, with no picture published, and published by its holder on {date}. The passport id is the sha256 of the file, so anyone can hash the published picture and compare.

unseal.heading: Publish the picture
unseal.body: Choose the signed file you saved when you registered. The service checks that it is the registered file, then pins it.
unseal.permanent: This cannot be undone. Once the picture is published it is public and permanent, and anyone can fetch it.
unseal.checking: Checking this file on your device
unseal.matchedLine: Its hash is the passport id {id}. Nothing has left this device yet.
unseal.sending: Pinning the picture, its thumbnail and its manifest

done.label: Published
done.body: The picture, its thumbnail and its manifest are on IPFS, and a small record beside them says where. Nothing on chain changed, because nothing can: this passport's metadata address was written once and has no setter.
done.check: Anyone can fetch the picture, hash it and compare it with the passport id on Monad. That is the whole proof, and it needs nothing from this service.

failure.notTheFile: This is not the registered file. The passport commits to the exact file the service signed and handed back, not to your own copy of the picture.
failure.fingerprintMismatch: The bytes hash right and the fingerprint read from them is not the one on chain, so nothing was published.
failure.notHolder: The registry says another wallet holds this passport, so only that wallet can publish the picture.
failure.noPassport: The registry has no passport with this id.
failure.notSealed: This passport's picture is already public, so there is nothing left to publish.
failure.alreadyUnsealed: This passport has been published already. Open the page again to see the picture.
failure.thumbnailTooLarge: This picture cannot be reduced to a thumbnail small enough for the Chainlink verifier to fetch, so publishing it would leave a passport nobody can ever re-check. Nothing was pinned.
failure.quota: That is {used} of {limit} for today. The allowance comes back at {at}.
failure.todayFull: Everyone's budget for publishing today is spent. Nothing was pinned and nothing was spent. Try again tomorrow.
failure.pinFailed: The picture could not be pinned to IPFS, so nothing was published.
failure.recordPinFailed: The picture is published and the record that points at it is not. Send the same file again to finish it: nothing is pinned twice.
failure.dependencyDown: A service this needs did not answer, so nothing was published and nothing was spent. Try again in a minute.
failure.lookupUnavailable: The service could not find out whether this passport has been published already, so it published nothing. Try again in a moment.
failure.busy: The service is handling as many pictures at once as it can. Try again in a moment.
failure.signedOut: This session is signed out, so the service would not take the file.
failure.notAnImage: That is not an image file. Choose the signed file you saved.
failure.tooLarge: That file is over the 20 MB limit.
failure.empty: That file is empty. Choose the file again.
failure.unreadable: This file could not be read from your device. Choose it again.
failure.rateLimited: Too many requests from here for now. Wait a moment and try again.
failure.badRequest: The service turned the request down.
failure.badResponse: The service answered in a shape this app does not know.
failure.offline: The verify service did not answer, so nothing was published.
failure.fileMissing: Choose the file you saved first.
failure.unknown: Something went wrong before the file was sent.
failure.serviceFault: This was a fault on Moolam's side, not a problem with your picture. Nothing was saved. Try again in a minute.
failure.unsealInProgress: This picture is already being published from another tab or device. Give it a moment, then reload the passport.
failure.thumbnailHeldPrivately: Nothing was published. A private copy of this same picture, kept for another passport, is in the way of its public copy. Try again later.
failure.fingerprintUnstable: This picture changes too little from side to side for a fingerprint that survives copying, so its public copy could never pass the Chainlink re-check. Nothing was published.

privateCopy.heading: Moolam's private copy
privateCopy.body: Moolam keeps one small copy of this picture, 512 pixels on its longest side, so a Chainlink confidential workflow can re-check it. Only you can delete it.
privateCopy.confirm: This cannot be undone. Without the copy no private re-check can run again, and the passport stays sealed.
privateCopy.done: Deleted. Moolam keeps nothing of this picture now.

failure.signedOut: This session is signed out, so the service would not delete anything.
failure.notHolder: The registry says another wallet holds this passport, so only that wallet can delete the copy.
failure.noPassport: The registry has no passport with this id.
failure.nothingKept: This passport never asked for a private copy, so there is nothing to delete.
failure.deleteFailed: Part of the delete did not go through, so the copy may still be kept. Press Delete again to finish it.
failure.dependencyDown: A service this needs did not answer, so nothing was deleted. Try again in a minute.
failure.rateLimited: Too many requests from here for now. Wait a moment and try again.
failure.badRequest: The service turned the request down.
failure.badResponse: The service answered in a shape this app does not know.
failure.offline: The verify service did not answer, so nothing was deleted.
failure.unknown: Something went wrong before the request was sent.

unsealed.label: Sealed at first
unsealed.line: Registered with no picture published, and published by its holder on {date}. The file's hash is the passport id.

agent.title: Agent
agent.notFound: No agent with that id on the ERC-8004 identity registry.
agent.error: The identity registry could not be read: {reason}. Reload the page.
agent.cardMissing: The agent card could not be read from its URI.

reputation.heading: Reputation feedback on the ERC-8004 registry
reputation.empty: No feedback recorded for this agent yet. The verifier writes one after every check it runs.
reputation.error: The reputation registry could not be read: {reason}.
reputation.body: Feedback lives on Monad's public agent review board (the ERC-8004 reputation registry), filed under Moolam's checks. This page reads its summary. The trust score beside it comes from the index's own re-checks, so the two are never added together.
reputation.secondary: Feedback the verifier wrote on chain, not the re-check score

agent.unnamed: This agent's card carries no name

index.heading: What the index has counted
index.trustScoreBody: Out of 100, from re-checks that matched, re-checks that did not, and any upheld dispute. Smoothed, so one lucky check cannot make it 100.
index.empty: The index has not seen this agent sign a passport yet.
index.error: The index could not be read: {reason}.
index.formulaLink: How the score is worked out
index.formulaPlain: Each re-check that matched raises the score and each miss lowers it; an upheld dispute counts as two misses. A new agent starts at 50.

signs.heading: How this agent signs
signs.body: An agent's name is only as good as the account behind it. The registry checks that link itself, on every registration, before it writes anything.

sign.title: The agent signs the fingerprint
sign.body: The wallet that owns agent {id} signs a short summary of the picture: its fingerprints, who made it, which agent drew it, and a time limit. The picture never leaves the fingerprint.

recover.title: The registry recovers the signer
recover.body: The registry works out from the signature itself who signed. Nothing is taken on trust from whoever sent the transaction.

own.title: It has to be the owner
own.body: That signer is checked against the owner listed in the public agent registry (ERC-8004). If they differ, Monad refuses the registration and no passport is made.

signs.privyBody: These values come from the agent's own card, not from this app.

works.heading: What it has signed
works.empty: No passport names this agent yet.
works.error: The index could not be read: {reason}.

agent.cardInline: This card is carried inside the token URI itself, so there is nothing to open.
agent.ipfsCid: Open the stored record on IPFS

studio.title: Register an image
studio.lede: Every image you register here gets its own record on Monad: fingerprinted, signed by you, findable from any copy.
studio.noWallet: You are signed in, but no account was created on Monad yet. Reload the page, or sign out and sign in again.
studio.notConfigured: Privy is not configured, so nobody can sign in here. Put NEXT_PUBLIC_PRIVY_APP_ID in packages/web/.env.local and restart the dev server.

identity.gasProven: Paid by Moolam. Your balance did not move.
identity.kindPasskey: a passkey, with no email on file
identity.passkeySigned: Signed with this device's own key, no seed phrase.

signedOut.heading: Sign in and an account is made for you
signedOut.body: There is no wallet to install and no seed phrase to write down. Sign in with your email, your Google account or a passkey, and Privy creates an account on Monad in your name.
signedOut.button: Sign in and create my account
signedOut.methods: Email, Google or a passkey. Whichever you choose, the account is yours.

wallet.label: Your account
wallet.body: Made the moment you sign in, held by Privy, and nobody at Moolam can sign with it.

passkey.label: Your signature
passkey.body: The fingerprint or face unlock on this device signs each image. It never leaves the device.

gas.label: The network fee
gas.body: Moolam pays it through Privy, so registering an image costs you nothing.

consent.label: Your word on AI use
consent.body: You say how AI may use it: open to AI, not for AI training, or ask me first. Your answer is signed into the file and written to Monad with the date, and you can change it later.

passkey.reading: Checking whether this account already has a passkey
passkey.unreadable: Monad could not be read, so this page does not know whether your account has a passkey yet: {reason}. Reload the page.

bind.heading: Link this device to your account
bind.body: Your account has no signature on it yet. Bind the unlock on this device once and it becomes the signature on every image you register.
bind.plain: A passkey is the fingerprint, face unlock or PIN this device already uses. It stays on the device: Moolam only ever sees the public half.
bind.creating: Making a passkey on this device
bind.waiting: Waiting for your fingerprint or face unlock
bind.sending: Sending it to Monad, network fee sponsored
bind.confirming: Waiting for Monad to record your passkey
bind.doneBody: This device now signs for your account. Register an image and it will ask for your unlock once.

recover.heading: Your passkey was set up somewhere else
recover.body: Monad says this account already has a passkey, and this browser has never used it. Unlock with that passkey here and you can carry on, or bind this device instead.
recover.waiting: Waiting for your fingerprint or face unlock
recover.otherDevice: If that passkey lives on your phone or another laptop, open Moolam there, or bind this device instead. Binding replaces the old one and costs one transaction.

upload.label: Upload a picture
upload.note: One you already made. Your unlock signs it.

generate.label: Make one with the agent
generate.note: The agent draws it and signs it beside you.

register.heading: Give an image its passport
register.body: One picture at a time. It is fingerprinted and pinned, you sign it with your unlock, and Moolam sends it to Monad.
register.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 20 MB. Moolam embeds a C2PA manifest, fingerprints the signed bytes and pins the file to IPFS.
register.title: Title
register.titleHint: It goes into the manifest and the metadata, so keep it the name you would call the picture.

prepare.waiting: Fingerprint and pin the file, about ten seconds
prepare.running: Fingerprinting and pinning, about ten seconds
prepare.done: Fingerprinted, manifest embedded, pinned to IPFS

sign.running: Waiting for your fingerprint or face unlock

send.waiting: Send it to Monad, network fee sponsored
send.running: Sending to Monad, network fee sponsored
send.watching: Waiting for Monad to record the passport
send.pending: Sent, and Monad has not shown it yet

register.doneHeading: This image now has a passport
register.doneBody: Any copy of it, resized, re-encoded or turned sideways, can be traced back to this record from the verify page.

generate.heading: Let the agent draw it
generate.body: Say what you want. The generator agent draws it, pins it, and signs the passport with its own wallet. You sign the same passport with your unlock. Two signatures, one transaction.
generate.promptPlaceholder: A fishing boat leaving a harbour at first light, seen from the water
generate.promptHint: Between 8 and 600 characters. Your prompt is kept in the metadata, so it stays readable next to the picture.
generate.examplesLabel: Or start from one of these

examples.one: A fishing boat leaving a harbour at first light, seen low from the water
examples.two: A rain-wet street at night, one shop sign lit, nobody in the frame
examples.three: A paper map of a coastline, folded and worn, photographed flat on a desk

generate.title: Title
generate.titlePlaceholder: What should this picture be called?
generate.titleHint: It goes into the manifest and the metadata, beside the prompt.
generate.quotaResets: Your next one opens up at {time}.
generate.quotaSpent: Today's pictures are used up. The next one opens up at {time}.
generate.plateWaiting: The picture appears here the moment the agent is done with it.

draw.waiting: The agent draws the picture, up to sixty seconds
draw.running: The agent is drawing this, up to sixty seconds

pin.waiting: Pin the picture, its thumbnail and its metadata to IPFS

agentSign.waiting: The agent signs the passport with its own wallet

sign.waiting: Sign the same passport with your unlock

send.waiting: Send it to Monad, network fee sponsored
send.running: Sending to Monad, network fee sponsored
send.watching: Waiting for Monad to record the passport
send.pending: Sent, and Monad has not shown it yet

signatures.heading: Two signatures, one transaction
signatures.body: The registry takes this passport only when both names are on it. Watch them arrive.
signatures.agentWaiting: Signs once the picture is pinned
signatures.agentDetail: Signed by a Privy server wallet under a policy that allows only this.
signatures.youWaiting: Your unlock signs the same passport
signatures.youDetail: Your fingerprint or face unlock, on this device, over the same digest.

generate.doneHeading: An agent made this, and you both signed for it
generate.doneBody: The passport says which agent drew it and which account asked for it. Any copy of the picture leads back to this record from the verify page.

consent.heading: Say how AI may use it
consent.body: It goes inside the file before anything is signed, and onto Monad the moment the passport is written. One statement, in two places that both hold.
consent.hint: Saying nothing is a choice too, and it gives nobody permission. You can state it later from the passport page.
consent.needsConditions: Write your conditions above. They travel inside the picture and go on chain with it.

receipt.label: How AI may use it
receipt.sendingDetail: The same words that went into the file, now going to the consent register on Monad.
receipt.pending: Sent, and Monad has not shown it yet
receipt.pendingDetail: Nothing has been sent a second time. Ask Monad again in a moment.
receipt.sponsored: Network fee paid by Moolam through Privy.
receipt.own: Network fee paid from your own balance.
receipt.later: The passport is on chain. You can write the statement from its own page whenever you like.
receipt.noneDetail: Silence is not permission. You can state it from the passport page at any time.

switch.label: Keep this picture sealed
switch.note: Moolam publishes the passport, not the picture. Save the file we hand back: it is the only copy that can unseal this passport.
switch.panelLine: Everything below goes out the moment you sign, and nothing can be taken back off an immutable registry. The picture itself is not on the list.
switch.sketchCaption: The whole of the picture that becomes public.
switch.promptNote: The prompt stays private unless you include it.
switch.privateNote: Moolam keeps one small copy, 512 pixels on its longest side, on private storage. A Chainlink confidential workflow opens it to re-check the fingerprint and writes only the verdict to Monad.
switch.privateWho: Nobody can open it from the web. Moolam's operator and the storage provider can. Today the workflow runs in Chainlink's simulator, not inside Chainlink's secure hardware. You can delete the copy from the passport page at any time.

commitment.label: The passport id
commitment.line: The sha-256 of the file we hand back. The chain commits to the exact bytes without showing them.

fingerprint.label: The two fingerprints
fingerprint.line: A 64 bit perceptual hash, and the 16 by 16 block hash drawn above. Rough light and dark, nothing finer.

name.label: The title you type
name.line: Whatever you name it is the name everyone reads, so name it with that in mind.

description.label: The line Moolam writes
description.line: One fixed sentence saying how this passport was made. It never describes the picture.

creator.label: Your wallet address
creator.line: The registry records who registered it, the way it does for every passport.

generator.label: The agent id
generator.line: Which Moolam agent drew it, and the ERC-8004 registry it is identified in.

createdAt.label: The date
createdAt.line: The moment this record was made, which is the whole point of registering early.

training.label: Your statement on AI use
training.line: The four answers you gave above, in the words the CAWG standard uses.

sealed.label: The word sealed
sealed.line: So a passport page, Explore and a link preview all say the picture is not published.

model.label: Which model drew it
model.line: The name of the image model, the same as on a published passport.

prompt.label: The prompt
prompt.line: Words that describe the picture, so it stays out of the file unless you put it in.

privateRecheck.label: That you asked for a private re-check
privateRecheck.line: One word in the pinned file, so a passport page can say it. The copy's address is never in it.

plate.line: The picture is not published. You hold the only copy.
plate.linePrivate: The picture is not published. You hold the only full copy.
plate.registered: Registered {date}. The picture is not published.

handback.heading: The signed file is in this browser
handback.body: Moolam pinned nothing of the picture and kept nothing. Save it before you close this page.
handback.bodyPrivate: Moolam pinned nothing of the picture itself. It keeps only the small private copy you asked for. Save the signed file before you close this page.
handback.saved: Saved. Keep it somewhere you will find it again.
handback.only: This is the only copy that can unseal this passport.

done.label: Sealed on Monad
done.body: The picture is not published. Moolam keeps no copy.
done.bodyPrivate: The picture is not published. Moolam keeps only the small private copy you asked for.

receipt.label: Sealed on Monad
receipt.detail: The picture is not published. Moolam keeps no copy.
receipt.detailPrivate: The picture is not published. Moolam keeps only the small private copy you asked for.
receipt.fingerprintDetail: Taken from the signed file, which never left this browser. C2PA manifest embedded: {manifest}.
receipt.privateDetail: For Chainlink's private re-check. <page>Delete it from the passport page whenever you like.</page>
receipt.noPrivateDetail: You asked for a private re-check and the service kept no copy, so this passport has none. It is sealed and nothing of it was kept.

receipt.heading: What just happened
receipt.body: Every step gets stamped here as it lands. Nothing on this list is a guess.
receipt.empty: Nothing yet. Sign in and the first stamp appears.
receipt.accountDetail: Privy verified this before an account was made.
receipt.walletDetail: Created on sign in. No seed phrase, and no key Moolam holds.
receipt.passkeyDetail: The public half of this device's unlock, stored by the registry.
receipt.pinnedDetail: The signed bytes, the thumbnail and the metadata all went to IPFS.
receipt.downloadHelp: The signed file, with its Content Credentials: a copy of it still verifies against this passport.
receipt.signedDetail: Read from the contract, signed by your unlock, checked here before it was sent.
receipt.sentSponsored: Network fee paid by Moolam through Privy.
receipt.sentOwn: Network fee paid from your own balance.
receipt.blockPending: Recorded. The block number comes from the index.
receipt.confirmedDetail: Measured in this browser, from handing the send to Privy to Monad answering.
receipt.sealedAfter: The block was sealed {seconds, plural, =1 {one second} other {# seconds}} after you tapped.
receipt.sealedUnderSecond: The block was sealed under a second after you tapped.
receipt.billedSponsored: Billed {gas, number} gas, {fee} MON, paid by Moolam through Privy.
receipt.billedOwn: Billed {gas, number} gas, {fee} MON, from your own balance.
receipt.wouldHaveCost: It would have cost you {fee} MON.
receipt.cameraKept: Your camera's own record is kept, with its location and serial number removed.
receipt.cameraDropped: Your camera's own record was removed, because its location could not be taken out cleanly.
receipt.credentialsKept: This file's earlier Content Credentials are kept inside Moolam's, with any location and serial removed.

passports.heading: Your pictures
passports.reading: Reading everything this account has registered.
passports.unreadable: Your passports could not be read: {reason}. Reload the page.
passports.empty: Nothing registered from this account yet. The first image you register appears here within a block.

failure.serviceOffline: The Moolam verify service is not answering, so nothing was uploaded. Try again in a moment.
failure.signedOut: Your session has expired. Sign in again and the upload will work.
failure.tooLarge: That file is over the 20 MB limit. Export it smaller and try again.
failure.signedFileTooLarge: Adding the passport's signature would take this file past 20 MB, the most a check can read back. Export it smaller and try again. Nothing was pinned.
failure.notAnImage: That file is not a JPEG, a PNG or a WebP image. Choose an image file.
failure.empty: That file is empty. Choose the picture again.
failure.rateLimited: This account has prepared 20 images in the last hour, which is the limit. Try again later.
failure.pinFailed: The image could not be pinned to IPFS, so nothing was registered. Try again in a moment.
failure.badRequest: The verify service refused this upload. What it said is below.
failure.badResponse: The verify service answered in a shape this page does not understand, so nothing was signed. Try again.
failure.authCheck: The signature from your device would be refused by the registry, so it was not sent. Try again, and use the same unlock you bound.
failure.passkeyCancelled: The unlock prompt was closed or it timed out. Nothing was signed.
failure.passkeyOrigin: This passkey belongs to a different website, so this page cannot use it.
failure.passkeyUnsupported: This browser or device cannot make the kind of passkey the registry needs. Try a browser with fingerprint or face unlock.
failure.passkeyOther: The unlock did not finish. Your device said this:
failure.alreadyRegistered: This exact image is already registered. The first registration wins, so open the passport that holds it.
failure.expired: The hour that signature was good for has passed. Register the image again.
failure.notBound: Monad says your account has no passkey on it. Bind this device's unlock, then register the image.
failure.badSignature: The registry refused that signature. Sign again with the unlock you bound to this account.
failure.badKey: The registry refused that passkey. Bind this device's unlock again.
failure.paused: The registry is paused, so nothing can be registered right now. Try again later.
failure.wrongWallet: The image was signed for a different account than the one sending it. Reload the page and register again.
failure.rejected: The registry refused this passport. The error it gave is below.
failure.reverted: Monad refused this transaction. The error the contract gave is below.
failure.sponsorship: Privy would not pay the network fee for this transaction. What it said is below. You can send the same transaction and pay the fee yourself.
failure.confirmPending: Your send was accepted and Monad has not shown it yet. It may still land, so nothing has been sent a second time. Open your account below to look, or ask Monad again.
failure.sendCancelled: You closed the confirmation, so nothing was sent.
failure.sendFailed: This step did not finish. The network's own words are below. Try again in a moment.
failure.digestMismatch: The network answered with a different record than the one on this page, so nothing was signed. Try a different network setting.
failure.passkeyNotReady: This page has not finished reading your passkey from Monad. Give it a moment and try again.
failure.unknown: Something went wrong before anything was sent. The message is below.
failure.titleMissing: Give the picture a title first. It goes into the manifest.
failure.quotaReached: You have had every picture the agent draws for one account in a day. The count under the button says when the next one opens up.
failure.promptRefused: The model would not draw this prompt. Its own reason is below. Edit the prompt and ask again.
failure.creatorMismatch: The account signed in now is not the one this picture was being drawn for. Sign out, sign in again, and ask for it once more.
failure.deadlinePassed: The picture was drawn, but too little of the signing window was left for the agent to sign it. It still counted against today's allowance. Make it again and the window starts fresh.
failure.modelFailed: The model did not finish this picture. It may have drawn before it failed, so that one still counts against today's total.
failure.agentSignFailed: The picture was drawn and pinned, and the agent's wallet would not sign the passport. Try again. If it keeps happening, the policy on the agent's wallet is the likely cause.
failure.agentBusy: Moolam is handling as many pictures at once as it can. Try again in a minute.
failure.promptTooShort: Write a few more words. The agent needs at least eight characters to draw from.
failure.promptTooLong: That prompt is longer than 600 characters. Shorten it and ask again.
failure.sealedMismatch: The file we got back does not match the passport. Nothing was registered. Try again.
failure.sealedNotHeld: The verify service did not hand back the sealed file, so nothing was signed. Try again.
failure.sealedRecordRefused: The verify service refused to publish this sealed record, so nothing was pinned and nothing was registered. Try again.
failure.sealedFileRefused: The verify service could not hand back a file matching this passport, so nothing was pinned and nothing was registered. Try again.
failure.privateRecheckNeedsSealed: The verify service will not keep a private copy of a picture that is not sealed, so nothing was pinned and nothing was registered. Reload the studio and try again.
failure.privateCopyNotPrivate: The storage provider did not keep the small copy private, so Moolam stopped and nothing was pinned or registered. Turn the private re-check off to register this picture sealed without it.
failure.privateChainUnreachable: Moolam could not reach Monad to check this picture is new, so it kept no private copy and registered nothing. Try again in a moment.
failure.privateThumbnailTooLarge: This picture cannot be reduced to a thumbnail small enough for the Chainlink verifier to fetch, so its passport could never be re-checked, and a sealed one could never be published later. Nothing was pinned.
failure.fingerprintUnstable: This picture changes too little from side to side for a fingerprint that survives copying: even its own small copy reads as a different picture, so the Chainlink re-check and any search for its copies would miss it. Nothing was pinned and nothing was registered. A picture with more detail across its width will register.
failure.serviceFault: This was a fault on Moolam's side, not a problem with your picture. Nothing was saved. Try again in a minute.

actions.unsponsored: Send it and pay the fee myself

studio.showcaseCaption: A real passport on Monad. This is what you get.

resolve.title: Resolve disputes
resolve.heading: Settle the open challenges
resolve.lede: Every challenge the registry still has open, with the picture, the claim and the bond behind it. Anyone can read it; only the named resolver settles it.
resolve.policyNote: The policy contract names one address, and changing it waits 24 hours in the open, so anyone watching can react before it takes effect.
resolve.stranger: This page is for the resolver named by the policy.
resolve.strangerBody: You are signed in as {wallet}, so the registry would refuse anything sent from here.
resolve.signedOut: Sign in with the resolver's account to settle a challenge. Reading this page needs no account.
resolve.creditBody: Money here is pulled, never pushed. A settled dispute records a credit, and nothing reaches an account until that account asks for it.
resolve.withdrawn: Paid out. The credit is back to zero.
resolve.empty: No challenge is open. Nothing here is waiting on you.
resolve.error: The policy could not be read: {reason}
resolve.unavailable: The list of open disputes comes from the index, and the index did not answer: {reason}
resolve.noReason: The evidence for this one is a link rather than text: {uri}
resolve.unverified: The index and the registry disagree on the evidence for this one, so the claim is not printed here. Read the record itself before settling it.
resolve.upholdWhat: Uphold marks the record disputed for good and credits the bond back to the challenger.
resolve.rejectWhat: Reject leaves the record standing and credits the bond to the treasury.
resolve.watching: Waiting for Monad to show it
resolve.settledUpheld: Upheld. The bond is credited back to the challenger.
resolve.settledRejected: Rejected. The bond is credited to the treasury.

failure.notResolver: The registry refused this: the account that sent it is not the resolver the policy names.
failure.noOpenDispute: There is no open dispute on that passport any more.
failure.nothingOwed: The registry owes this account nothing right now.
failure.notEnough: The account could not cover this transaction.
failure.declined: The window was closed before the transaction went out. Nothing was sent.
failure.confirmPending: It was accepted and Monad has not shown it yet. It may still land, so it must not be sent again.
failure.reverted: Monad rejected this, so nothing was written

notFound.title: Not on Moolam
notFound.lede: This page does not exist, or this passport or agent is not on Moolam.

error.title: Something broke
error.lede: This page could not be shown just now. Nothing on Monad is affected: every passport is still in the registry. Try the page again, or take one of the ways back.

retry.countdown: Trying again in {seconds, plural, =1 {# second} other {# seconds}}
retry.stopped: Still unreachable. The registry itself is on Monad and the passport pages read it directly.

recheck.note: Free. Chainlink's workflow re-fetches the picture and writes its verdict on Monad. The verdict usually lands on chain within a few minutes.
recheck.already: Already requested {at}. Position {position} in the queue.
recheck.alreadyWaiting: Already requested {at}. Waiting in the queue.
recheck.running: Running now: the workflow is fetching the picture and hashing it again.
recheck.doneNoTime: Done: this picture has been re-checked.
recheck.failedNoReason: Could not run. The runner did not say why.
recheck.stopped: This page stopped checking after half an hour. Press to look again.

failure.noPassport: The verify service does not know this passport, so there is nothing for it to re-check.
failure.sealed: This passport's picture was never published, so the workflow has nothing to fetch.
failure.queueFull: The queue is full of requests nobody has run yet. Try again later.
failure.rateLimited: Too many requests from here, wait a minute.
failure.notAnswering: The verify service is not answering just now.
failure.unknown: The request did not go through.

recheck.notePrivate: Free. Chainlink's confidential workflow opens the small private copy Moolam keeps, compares the fingerprint and writes its verdict on Monad. The verdict usually lands on chain within a few minutes.
recheck.runningPrivate: Running now: the workflow is opening the private copy and comparing the fingerprint.
recheck.confirming: The queue says this run finished. It shows as done once its verdict can be read on Monad.

mine.title: Your pictures
mine.description: Every picture you have registered here, read from the index with your own account.
mine.heading: Made by you
mine.lede: Every picture your account registered, read from the index.

signedOut.heading: Sign in to see every picture you registered
signedOut.body: The list is read from the index against your account's address, so the same pictures come back on any device you sign in on.

mine.showcaseCaption: A real passport on Monad. Yours will sit here like this one.
